acceptance.given: Frontmatter input is supplied to the parser and may be malformed or adversarial.

oracle.expected: Parsing returns structured data or a controlled validation error without executing arbitrary code or changing host-process state.
forbidden: Parsing side effects alter the host process
oracle.observable: Parser return value/error and a side-effect sentinel show safe completion.

acceptance.then: Safe parsing completes with parsed data or a controlled validation error.
acceptance.when: When frontmatter parsing is executed against valid, malformed, and adversarial inputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute frontmatter parser safety cases with adversarial YAML/object-constructor input and observe the runtime safety assertion fail if code execution or process mutation occurs.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Parse frontmatter without arbitrary execution or host-process side effects.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Parser behavior change only; no persisted state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frontmatter input transitions to parsed data or controlled error with process state intact.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Safety tests observe no arbitrary execution and accept either parsed data or a controlled error.

acceptance.given: A Skill package lacks the required frontmatter block.

oracle.expected: The validator reports the package as invalid with a missing-frontmatter diagnostic.
forbidden: A package without frontmatter is accepted
Missing frontmatter is treated as valid
oracle.observable: Validator result contains an invalid status and missing-frontmatter finding.

acceptance.then: Validation fails with a missing-frontmatter result.
acceptance.when: When validation encounters a package without frontmatter.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the missing-frontmatter fixture through the validator and observe the negative assertion fail if validation succeeds.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject packages that omit the required frontmatter block.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation result change only; no persisted state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package moves from missing-frontmatter input to invalid validation state.
